_comment: Meaning of each ApiScope value (apps/api/src/core/constant/apikey.constant.ts). scripts/generate.mjs fails on an enum value with no entry here. `checked` is what really consumes the scope today (re-verified 2026-10-07: tunnel:connect by the hub, and since phase 7 the platform API scopes by the routes that declare config.apiKeyScope).

tunnel:connect.description: Connect an agent to the hub, and register a `TunnelClient` session.
tunnel:connect.checked: Yes. The hub requires it for agent registration and for `TunnelClient` connections and requests.

tunnel:read.checked: No. Accepted when creating a key; nothing requires it yet.

tunnel:write.checked: No. Accepted by the API when creating a key; nothing requires it yet.

webhook:receive.checked: No. The [webhook inbox](/dashboard/webhook-inbox) is managed from the dashboard with your sign-in, not with an API key; nothing requires this scope.

webhook:inspect.checked: No. The [request inspector](/dashboard/request-inspector) is used from the dashboard with your sign-in, not with an API key; nothing requires this scope.

metrics:read.checked: No. Accepted when creating a key; nothing requires it yet.

mocks:read.description: Read mock APIs: the list, definitions, OpenAPI and file exports, and dry runs (try).
mocks:read.checked: Yes. The [platform API](/reference/platform-api) requires it on those routes of `/api/v1/mocks`.

mocks:write.description: Create, change, import into and delete mock APIs.
mocks:write.checked: Yes. Required by those routes of `/api/v1/mocks`. Recording from captured traffic and resetting resource data stay dashboard actions.

specs:read.description: Read API docs: specs, drafts, versions, diffs and exports; check a document against the latest version; compare a spec with live traffic (drift).
specs:read.checked: Yes. Required by the read routes of `/api/v1/specs`, by API drift, and by `vhyxvoid spec check`.

specs:write.description: Create specs, save drafts and publish versions.
specs:write.checked: Yes. Required by those routes of `/api/v1/specs`; `vhyxvoid spec push` also needs `specs:read`. Restoring an old version, sharing, docs domains and deleting stay dashboard actions.

collections:read.description: Read API client collections, their exports and runs, and the names of environments.
collections:read.checked: Yes. Required by those routes of `/api/v1/api-client`. Environment values, history and single sends stay in the dashboard.

tests:run.description: Run collections, create collections and replace one from a file.
tests:run.checked: Yes. Required by the create, save, parse and run routes of `/api/v1/api-client`. `vhyxvoid test --collection` and `vhyxvoid collection push` also need `collections:read` to find the collection by name.

team:read.description: Read the team space: the channel list, channel messages, search, documents, issues and comments.
team:read.checked: Yes. Required by those routes of `/api/v1/team`.

team:write.description: Post channel messages, create and edit documents, open, update and move issues, and comment, as the key's creator.
team:write.checked: Yes. Required by those routes of `/api/v1/team`. Channels, folders, deleting and editing messages stay dashboard actions.

ai:use.description: Draft mock APIs and test collections with [AI assist](/dashboard/ai-assist).
ai:use.checked: Yes. Required by `/api/v1/ai` and by `vhyxvoid ai`. Drafts count against the plan limit `aiRequestsPerMonth`.

*.checked: Satisfies any scope check. Only an organization's owner can create a key that has it.
